title: Ordinary higher direct images are quasi-coherent
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $M$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $p\in\mathbf N$, the ordinary higher direct image $R^pf_*M$ is quasi-coherent. Here the ordinary higher image is the $p$-th right derived functor of module direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], not the higher image of an arbitrary derived object.

proof.text: To prove (1), restrict the derived direct image to an affine open $V\subseteq S$ using [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open]. On the affine base $S$, apply [lem-sc-invert-s-cohomology-induction] to the property that every $R^if_*\mathcal G$ is quasi-coherent for every quasi-coherent $\mathcal G$ on a quasi-compact open. On an affine open $U$, [lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi] gives the assertion in degree zero and the cited cohomology-presheaf statement together with [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] gives vanishing in positive degrees. For $U\cup V$ (with $U$ quasi-compact, $V$ affine, $a,b,c,g$ the restrictions of $f$ to $U,V,U\cap V,U\cup V$ and $\mathcal G$ quasi-coherent on $U\cup V$), apply [lem-sc-mayer-vietoris-open-cover] to the cover of $g^{-1}(T)$ by $a^{-1}(T)$ and $b^{-1}(T)$ for every open $T\subseteq S$; by its naturality in inclusions of open covers these long exact sequences form a long exact sequence of presheaves of $\mathcal O_S$-modules $T\mapsto H^p(g^{-1}(T),\mathcal G)$, etc. Sheafification is exact [lem-weil-pbc-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact] and by [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf] it turns these presheaves into $R^pg_*\mathcal G$, $R^pa_*(\mathcal G|_U)\oplus R^pb_*(\mathcal G|_V)$, $R^pc_*(\mathcal G|_{U\cap V})$, giving the relative Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequence, which expresses each cohomology sheaf as an extension of kernels and cokernels of maps between the corresponding quasi-coherent sheaves; kernels and cokernels are checked on affine opens, and [lem-pc-quasi-coherent-extension] gives quasi-coherence of the extensions. This proves (1) locally on $S$ and hence globally. The cited qcqs-open induction is the two-stage principle of Tag 08DR: first handle separated quasi-compact opens using affine intersections and induction on an affine cover, then handle general quasi-compact opens using that the overlap with the last affine open is a quasi-compact separated open. No induction hypothesis on the size of an arbitrary overlap cover is assumed.

theorem ordinaryHigherImage_isQuasicoherent
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent)
    (p : ℕ) :
    SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u}
      (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj M)
lean.note: Extracts only clause (1) of lem-pc-finite-support-hi into an acyclic interface. The existing ordinary theorem in DirectImage.Sections cannot be imported here: its proof-only imports reach TruncatedHigherImageQuasiCoherent.
